meta.name: get-available-resources
meta.description: Detect host inventory and effective CPU, memory, disk, scheduler, container, and accelerator limits when a user asks for resource-aware planning or before a clearly resource-sensitive local workload. Produces a redacted JSON snapshot and conservative planning helpers without stress tests or assuming visible host hardware is usable.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检测主机资源限制并输出JSON快照
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要了解本地机器资源限制后再运行任务
copy.tagline_en: Detect host resource limits and output JSON snapshot
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to know your local machine's resource limits before running tasks

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会在开始计算密集型任务前自动检测主机的CPU、GPU、内存、磁盘等资源,生成一个JSON快照文件(默认.claude_resources.json),并据此给出并行处理、内存策略、GPU加速等建议。
howto.when: 当用户提出资源密集型任务(如数据分析、模型训练、并行处理、大文件操作),或在项目初始化时,该技能会被触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这个50GB的基因组数据
say.note: 会先检测资源,判断是否需要Dask/Zarr。

say.text: 在这个数据上训练神经网络

say.note: 会检测CPU核数,给出建议的worker数量。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically detects the host's CPU, GPU, memory, disk, etc. before starting compute-intensive tasks, generates a JSON snapshot file (default .claude_resources.json), and provides recommendations on parallel processing, memory strategy, and GPU acceleration.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user proposes resource-intensive tasks (e.g., data analysis, model training, parallel processing, large file operations) or at project initialization.

say_en.text: Help me analyze this 50GB genomics dataset
say_en.note: It will first detect resources and decide if Dask/Zarr is needed.

say_en.text: Train a neural network on this data
say_en.note: It will detect available GPU and backends (e.g., CUDA, Metal).
It will detect CPU cores and suggest a worker count.
